prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent RGBA cutout asset sheet for a lovingly handmade paper pop-up mountain landscape in Pokémon Emerald's Hoenn. Twelve COMPLETE, separated flat paper objects in a 4-column by 3-row grid on a 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Generous transparent gutters, each object fully inside its own cell. No labels, no text, no grid, no background or stage.
Craft style: rich layered colored cardstock with thin cream cut edges, paper fibers, fold lines and small contact shadows BETWEEN thin layers. Rocks are overlapping flat irregular paper polygons with drawn cracks and lichen, never 3D faceted chunks. Moss and foliage are many small individually shaped cut-paper leaves. Palette warm grey/ochre rocks, sage and emerald vegetation, hazy blue distant mountains, delicate white/pale yellow flowers. Detailed and charming, readable silhouettes. Front-facing theatre flats with only small visible top surfaces where needed, no photographic or realistic rendering, no tiny noisy details.
Row 1 left to right: (1) tall asymmetrical mountain escarpment assembled from flat slate grey paper cliff layers, a narrow zig-zag hiking trail, moss, small grasses and tiny wildflowers; (2) a DIFFERENT stepped cliff with a narrow stone stairway, shrubs and lichen, no big doorway or arch; (3) a wind-bent tree with a crooked layered tan trunk and many small flat green leaves pointing to the right, exposed roots with little grass; (4) broad jagged distant pale blue mountain ridge with multiple irregular peaks, three overlapping shades of blue, no rectangular bottom block.
Row 2: (1) lower jagged middle-distance teal/blue ridge with individual slate silhouettes; (2) a DIFFERENT foreground grey-green low ridge with mossy peaks, irregular silhouette; (3) two separate cream cut-paper clouds of different sizes, arranged side by side with space; (4) two separate small cream paper birds with wings in different poses, generous gap, no strings.
Row 3: (1) low irregular pile of layered grey paper boulders with moss and small yellow flowers; (2) thick mountain grass and white daisies, each grass blade a separate folded paper shape; (3) flat shale scree pile with three small nearby separate loose paper stones, isolated shapes with transparent gaps; (4) a low crooked weathered log with moss and ferns in paper collage style.
No ball shell, no circular battle floor, no people or Pokemon. Every component has a complete irregular outline. Preserve real alpha transparency. This sheet will be assembled into MANY depth-separated cards inside a round pop-up ball.
alpha: Original RGBA copied unchanged; geometry selects each card.
